Q: What should a first text to an escort say?
A: Include your name, where you saw her ad, whether you want incall or outcall, and your preferred date and time. One complete message like this gets the fastest positive response; "Are you available?" alone usually gets ignored.

Q: Where is Morgan reviewed and verified?
